title: Three Saturdays and One Short Press
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：juice　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 juice 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1975 the farmer ① pressed the juice that no neighbour in the field would have recorded, and he said the pressing was the whole of the Saturday. The ② juice, meaning the liquid itself and not the press, ran three Saturdays and stayed unrecorded in the book; juice, he said, is the only thing in a field that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ kind of juice in that field had the same short press beside it, and the ④ juice at the far barrel, meaning the drop they kept for the children to taste and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Juice, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the farmer said the recording is the part that fills three Saturdays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the juice was the whole of the matter, meaning the freshness and not the liquid. The ⑥ juice, meaning the freshness and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; juice, he said, is either something you press or the only word that means both liquid and a freshness. He said the freshness is the part they remember.

By 1980 the ⑦ juice had become a line in a label, and the label had become an argument about the short press. The ⑧ juice of the whole thing, the farmer wrote in September, was one field and three Saturdays of recording; juice, he said, is either the drop at the far barrel or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ juice I remember is the juice recorded in the label, which closed in 1982 and is still recorded as the quietest in the field. ⑩ Juice, my mother said in 1984, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all juice, she said, is a freshness that has agreed to look like liquid. She said the freshness was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 汁；果汁（指田地里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 汁；果汁（指那杯汁液本身，与榨机相对）
C. 固定搭配：press the juice 榨取这些果汁
D. n. 汁；果汁（指留给孩子们尝的一滴那一杯）
E. n. 榨制之事（抽象总称，指一处田地的果汁之事）
F. n. 汁；果汁（指标签里写到、被记下的的那一杯）
G. n. 新鲜、滋味（指一件事里人人都榨却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 滋味（抽象总称，指人人都榨却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: pressed the juice that no neighbour in the field would have recorded

answers.why: press the juice 意为“榨取这些果汁”，1975 年那位农夫把田地里没有一位邻居肯记录的一杯果汁做了一遍。
juice 意为“汁；果汁”，指那杯汁液本身而不是榨机，它经过了三个星期六而在簿子上没有被记录。
juice 意为“汁；果汁”，指田地里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一台小小的榨机。
juice 意为“汁；果汁”，指最远那只木桶留给孩子们尝的一滴那一杯，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
juice 意为“新鲜、滋味”，指一件事里人人都榨却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份新鲜就是那件事的全部。
juice 意为“滋味”，指人人都榨却无人提起的那样东西而不是那杯汁液，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
juice 意为“汁；果汁”，指标签里写到、被记下的的那一杯，到 1980 年这一杯成了标签里的一行。
juice 意为“榨制之事”，农夫九月写道，整件事的果汁之事是一处田地和三个星期六的记录。
juice 意为“汁；果汁”，我记得的是标签里记录过的那一杯，1982 年榨完了，至今仍被说成田地里最安静的一杯。
juice 为抽象总称，母亲 1984 年说，果汁是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的汁液。
